definitions.explanation: The raised platform on which an orchestra conductor stands during a performance or rehearsal. Elevates the conductor so that all musicians can see the baton and gestures clearly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{指揮者|しきしゃ}→指揮者：06565_shikisha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{指揮|しき}{台|だい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}った→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: The conductor stepped onto the podium.

examples.japanese: {指揮|しき}{台|だい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見渡|みわた}して→見渡す：07169_miwatasu⟧⟦{指示|しじ}→指示：09674_shiji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: From atop the podium, the conductor surveys the ensemble and gives directions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧{指揮|しき}{台|だい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|あ}がり→上がる：00615_agaru⟧、⟦{拍手|はくしゅ}→拍手：03553_hakushu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{迎|むか}えられた→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
examples.english: The new music director stepped onto the podium for the first time and was greeted with applause.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{指揮|しき}→指揮：11102_shiki⟧ (conducting, command) and {台|だい} (stand, platform). The podium is a symbol of the conductor's authority and is central to the concert stage layout.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {指揮|しき}{台|だい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to stand on the podium
- {指揮|しき}{台|だい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧: to step up to the podium
- {指揮|しき}{台|だい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{降|お}りる→降りる：00568_oriru⟧: to step down from the podium
- {指揮|しき}{台|だい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧: in front of the podium

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{演壇|えんだん}→演壇：22662_endan⟧: lecture podium, lectern — the podium used for speeches, not music
- ⟦{指揮棒|しきぼう}→指揮棒：08114_shikibou⟧: baton — the stick the conductor holds
- ⟦{指揮者|しきしゃ}→指揮者：06565_shikisha⟧: conductor — the person who stands on the podium
